ABOUT & CONTACT

Hyeongmuk Lim (Mook).

Ph.D. Candidate in Physics at Seoul National University.

About my work

My research focuses on the topology and quantum geometry of electronic band structures. I am especially interested in how the geometric information of noninteracting wave functions constrains what may happen when electrons interact.

My work on quaternion-Kähler geometry of Kramers pairs provides a geometric framework for time-reversal-symmetric multiband states. I hope to explore how such structures can inform the study of correlated phases, without claiming that these phases have already been established by this approach.

Academic background

Advisor
Prof. Bohm-Jung Yang

Broader interests

Correlations in electronic bands, topological order, symmetry-protected topological phases, generalized symmetries, and the interplay between many-body physics and quantum geometry.
